front_blocks.md: What is the difference between training and development?

back_blocks.md: **Training** is teaching **new skills**; **development** is the **improvement of existing skills**.

cards.front_md: What is the difference between training and development?
cards.back_md: **Training** is teaching **new skills**; **development** is the **improvement of existing skills**.

front_blocks.md: Give two benefits of a well-trained workforce.

back_blocks.md: Staff are more **productive**, feel **valued**, and are more **loyal and flexible**.

cards.front_md: Give two benefits of a well-trained workforce.
cards.back_md: Staff are more **productive**, feel **valued**, and are more **loyal and flexible**.

front_blocks.md: Training can increase labour <u>  </u>, as employees who feel they are improving want to keep developing.

back_blocks.md: Training can increase labour **retention**, as employees who feel they are improving want to keep developing.

cards.front_md: Training can increase labour <u>  </u>, as employees who feel they are improving want to keep developing.
cards.back_md: Training can increase labour **retention**, as employees who feel they are improving want to keep developing.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Some training is required to meet legal requirements.

back_blocks.md: **True.**
E.g. **food safety**, **first-aid** and **hazardous chemicals** training are legally required.

front_blocks.md: Define **induction training**.

back_blocks.md: **Induction training** is training given to **new workers** as soon as they join a business.

cards.front_md: Define **induction training**.
cards.back_md: **Induction training** is training given to **new workers** as soon as they join a business.

front_blocks.md: What does induction training introduce employees to?

back_blocks.md: The **organisation, its culture, policies, procedures** and their **job roles and responsibilities**.

cards.front_md: What does induction training introduce employees to?
cards.back_md: The **organisation, its culture, policies, procedures** and their **job roles and responsibilities**.

front_blocks.md: Give one advantage of induction training.

back_blocks.md: It helps new employees **understand their roles**, boosts **confidence and motivation**, and **reduces time to become productive**.

cards.front_md: Give one advantage of induction training.
cards.back_md: It helps new employees **understand their roles**, boosts **confidence and motivation**, and **reduces time to become productive**.

front_blocks.md: Induction training usually includes a tour of the <u>  </u> and meeting key colleagues.

back_blocks.md: Induction training usually includes a tour of the **premises** and meeting key colleagues.

cards.front_md: Induction training usually includes a tour of the <u>  </u> and meeting key colleagues.
cards.back_md: Induction training usually includes a tour of the **premises** and meeting key colleagues.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Induction training is quick and cheap for a business to organise.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Induction training can be **time-consuming and expensive** to organise.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Induction training is quick and cheap for a business to organise.

**False.**

front_blocks.md: Which parts of induction training often need to be revisited regularly?

back_blocks.md: **Health and safety** training, and updates when **business policies change**.

cards.front_md: Which parts of induction training often need to be revisited regularly?
cards.back_md: **Health and safety** training, and updates when **business policies change**.

front_blocks.md: Give a real example of what induction training covers.

back_blocks.md: At **Marks & Spencer**, it covers **customer service, product knowledge, store policies and safety** procedures.

cards.front_md: Give a real example of what induction training covers.
cards.back_md: At **Marks & Spencer**, it covers **customer service, product knowledge, store policies and safety** procedures.

front_blocks.md: Define **on-the-job training**.

back_blocks.md: **On-the-job training** takes place **while employees are working** in their job roles, learning from colleagues.

cards.front_md: Define **on-the-job training**.
cards.back_md: **On-the-job training** takes place **while employees are working** in their job roles, learning from colleagues.

front_blocks.md: Give one advantage of on-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: It is **tailored** to the job, **practical and relevant**, and can be **cost-effective**.

cards.front_md: Give one advantage of on-the-job training.
cards.back_md: It is **tailored** to the job, **practical and relevant**, and can be **cost-effective**.

front_blocks.md: Give one disadvantage of on-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: Trainees may **make mistakes** or pick up **bad habits**, and it **takes up the trainer's time**.

cards.front_md: Give one disadvantage of on-the-job training.
cards.back_md: Trainees may **make mistakes** or pick up **bad habits**, and it **takes up the trainer's time**.

front_blocks.md: A sous chef learning from the Head Chef while working is an example of <u>  </u>-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: A sous chef learning from the Head Chef while working is an example of **on**-the-job training.

cards.front_md: A sous chef learning from the Head Chef while working is an example of <u>  </u>-the-job training.
cards.back_md: A sous chef learning from the Head Chef while working is an example of **on**-the-job training.

front_blocks.md: Define **off-the-job training**.

back_blocks.md: **Off-the-job training** takes place **away from or outside the workplace**, e.g. workshops, seminars or online courses.

cards.front_md: Define **off-the-job training**.
cards.back_md: **Off-the-job training** takes place **away from or outside the workplace**, e.g. workshops, seminars or online courses.

front_blocks.md: Give one advantage of off-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: It can bring **fresh ideas**, be **tailored** to the employee, and be used as a **reward** for high performers.

cards.front_md: Give one advantage of off-the-job training.
cards.back_md: It can bring **fresh ideas**, be **tailored** to the employee, and be used as a **reward** for high performers.

front_blocks.md: Give one disadvantage of off-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: It can be **expensive** (travel/accommodation), employees **miss work**, and it may **not be directly applicable**.

cards.front_md: Give one disadvantage of off-the-job training.
cards.back_md: It can be **expensive** (travel/accommodation), employees **miss work**, and it may **not be directly applicable**.

front_blocks.md: Teachers attending exam board training days to learn how to deliver a syllabus is an example of <u>  </u>-the-job training.

back_blocks.md: Teachers attending exam board training days to learn how to deliver a syllabus is an example of **off**-the-job training.

On-the-job training takes place away from the workplace.
